title: Travel line on the story card
caption: Basic, 1500 px: only the turn-in is left, its Kibelisk is bound and in another zone, so one line says to teleport there, with I'll walk.

title: Travel line and Prefer running
caption: Advanced shows the same line, and a Prefer running box under the header; ticking it turns the travel line off on this device.

title: Travel line on a phone
caption: On a phone in Basic the line sits under the card text, above Turned in; Basic has no settings, so no Prefer running box.

title: Travel line on a phone, Advanced
caption: On a phone in Advanced: Prefer running under the header, the line and a 44 px I'll walk button on the featured story card.
